title: Restriction of scalars commutes with intrinsic realization and pullback
statement: Let φ:A→B be a map of finite commutative rings, p:Z→Y any scheme morphism and N an arbitrary object of D(Y_et,B). Let F, a, L_A and U denote the intrinsic realization, its geometric inverse-mate comparison, pullback, and intrinsic restriction [def-fix-etale-origin-scalar-pullback-data]. Let ρ_T:F_T^B U_T≅U_et F_T^A be properOriginRestrictionIso [def-fix-proper-etale-origin-scalar-data], and a_i:L_A U_Y→U_Z L_B the specified restriction/pullback map. Then L_A(ρ_Y.inv_N);a_i(F_Y^B N);U_Z(a_B(N)) = a_A(U_et N);F_Z^A(a_et(N));ρ_Z.inv_(L_et,B N), where a_et is Etale.scalarRestrictionPullbackIso.hom. This tensor-free cube has no extension of scalars or right-adjoint projection.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleOriginRestrictionPullbackCube
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Z ⟶ Y)
    (N : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (ULift.{u + 1, u} B) Y) :
    (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A p).map
        ((properOriginRestrictionIso φ Y).inv.app N) ≫
      (originRestrictionPullback φ p).app
        ((finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Y B).obj N) ≫
      (scalarMateRestriction φ Z).mapDerivedCategory.map ((originPullback B p).app N) =
    (originPullback A p).app
        ((Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars Y.smallEtaleTopology
          (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ)).obj N) ≫
      (finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Z A).map
        ((Etale.scalarRestrictionPullbackIso
          (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) p).hom.app N) ≫
      (properOriginRestrictionIso φ Z).inv.app
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) p).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
          N)
